$comment: G1 hook runtime contract — SOURCE-DERIVED evidence, pinned from the official openai/codex checkout (post-0.150 codex-rs, cross-checked against on-device 0.150.1 and 0.148.0 behavior). Each entry names the source file it was verified against. This file is the executable-evidence anchor for SPEC G1 item 5 (timeout/stdout/unknown-field/concurrency) and item 6/7 (rotation, roots); it complements the on-device probe fixtures, which alone cannot cover macOS/Linux roots or Codex-internal runtime behavior.

hookTimeout.consequence: SessionEnd must never be used for transcript work; Stop (600s class) is the turn-complete worker.

hookConcurrency.consequence: PD runs sync hooks only; the hook must finish admission + durable enqueue and never await an LLM.

stdoutContract.inputSide: every hook input schema sets additionalProperties:false — Codex never sends unknown top-level fields
stdoutContract.outputSide: every hook output wire struct denies unknown fields; an unknown field makes Codex fail the whole hook run (sync control handlers report 'hook returned invalid ... JSON output')
stdoutContract.emptyStdout: empty/whitespace stdout is a legal no-op: parse_completed treats it as Completed (stop.rs trimmed_stdout.is_empty branch) — proven on-device by the probe hook exiting with empty stdout
stdoutContract.consequence: the PD encoder must emit only schema-known fields; PD-side whitelist enforcement must fail loud before Codex would

officialOutputSchemas.$comment: frozen from codex-rs/hooks/schema/generated, used by the encoder contract test; top-level and hookSpecificOutput properties with additionalProperties:false

Stop.$comment: Stop has NO hookSpecificOutput; its output is the universal field set only. PD emits empty stdout on Stop.

sessionRoots.source: codex-rs/utils/home-dir/src/lib.rs find_codex_home + codex-rs/core/src/config/mod.rs find_codex_home docs + on-device path shapes

configuredHome.rule: CODEX_HOME env var, when set and non-empty, MUST already exist and be a directory; the path is canonicalized before use; missing path or file path is a fatal error

defaultHome.rule: when CODEX_HOME is unset, the home directory comes from the dirs crate home_dir(): Windows %USERPROFILE%, macOS $HOME, Linux $HOME (passwd fallback); codex home = <home>/.codex
defaultHome.note: the default branch does NOT verify the directory exists; the configured branch does

sessionRoots.evidenceClass: Windows shapes are on-device evidence; the resolution RULES are source-pinned and OS-generic (single find_codex_home implementation, no per-OS branching beyond home_dir()). macOS/Linux on-device probes remain a rollout-support follow-up recorded in the G1 report.

transcriptLifetime.source: codex-rs/rollout/src/recorder.rs (RolloutCmd::AddItems/Persist/Flush, single writer task, append semantics) + codex-rs/core/src/thread_rollout_truncation.rs
transcriptLifetime.rotation: none — one rollout file per rollout identity, opened append-only for the file's lifetime; no size-based or time-based rotation mechanism exists in codex-rs/rollout
transcriptLifetime.archive: closed rollouts stay in place under sessions/YYYY/MM/DD; the archived_sessions directory observed on-device is a Desktop-app user archive copy, not a writer mechanism
transcriptLifetime.effectiveHistoryRewrite: compaction appends a `compacted` record (replacement_history); rollback appends a ThreadRolledBack marker (num_turns) — both are RECORDS appended to the same file, never file rewrites; a decoder must interpret them for logical history while physical ordinals stay append-only
transcriptLifetime.consequence: checkpoint + tail handling never needs to track file replacement/rotation; only growth, compacted/ThreadRolledBack interpretation, and incomplete tail retry.
